newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tidal wave alert after Japan shaken by tremor.
newsitem.headline: Tidal wave alert after Japan shaken by tremor.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 6.2 on the Richter scale shook Japan's southernmost main island of Kyushu on Friday, but there were no reports of damage, the Meteorological Agency said.

The agency issued tsunami, or tidal wave, alerts for areas along the coast of Kyushu and outlying islands after the tremor struck deep under Osumi village in Kagoshima prefecture, 800 km (500 miles) southwest of Tokyo.
